subject: Post-sale alignment: implementation owners & SOW
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Erin Dwyer <erin.dwyer@avahealth.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-sale alignment: implementation owners & SOW

Hi Erin —

Congrats again on the deal — excited to get Ava Health into production. Quick high-level alignment so CS/Implementation can start planning:

- Proposed go-live target: 2027-08-15 (customer-facing pilot + EMR sync).
- Initial scope: patient triage and discharge summary enrichment (no billing flows in phase 1).
- Integration ask: do you expect us to use FHIR R4 endpoints, or will you provide an HL7 v2 queue? If Epic/Cerner, please flag it — we’ll prepare the correct connector.
- Data residency: single-tenant (us-east) required per procurement notes.
- Target throughput: ~25 req/s initial (burst 100) — confirm if that aligns with your pilot expectations.

Attached: SOW_AvaHealth_v1.pdf and mutual_action_plan_AVH.xlsx (draft).

Next steps I recommend:
1) Introduce Tessa (CS lead) and Monica (Implementation PM) — they’ll run kickoff and staffing.
2) Customer to nominate a technical lead for EHR integration.
3) Kickoff week of June 5 or June 8 (Tessa, Monica — what works for you?).

Tessa — can you own the kickoff cadence and initial success criteria? Monica — can you start a RACI and initial sprint plan once Erin confirms the integration type and go-live window?

Erin — I’m cc’ing procurement if you want us to accept redlines and route SOW for countersignature.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

Best,
David Kim
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
https://redwoodinference.com

Attachments: SOW_AvaHealth_v1.pdf (20 pages, draft), mutual_action_plan_AVH.xlsx (workbook)
From: Erin Dwyer <erin.dwyer@avahealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ava Health Procurement <procurement@avahealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-sale alignment: implementation owners & SOW

Thanks David — really appreciate the quick summary. A few notes from our side:

- Go-live: Aug 15 is ambitious but possible. Note we have a compliance blackout July 20–31 (quarterly upgrade window) that will limit integration cutovers. If we need API-level changes, anything after July 15 is risky.
- Integration: Our technical team prefers FHIR R4 over HL7 v2. We run Epic with a FHIR facade (OAuth2).
- Technical lead: Tom Hsu (tom.hsu@avahealth.com), Senior Integrations Engineer — I’ll loop him into the kickoff.
- Procurement: I’ve cc’d procurement — they’ll review the SOW and send redlines; typical turnaround is 3–5 business days.

For the kickoff, June 8 at 10am PT could work if Tessa/Monica are available. If you can share a draft agenda and the roles you need from our side (tech, compliance, security), I’ll make sure the right people attend.

—Erin
VP, Product & Partnerships
Ava Health

On May 29, 2027 at 9:12 AM David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com> wrote:

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-sale alignment: implementation owners & SOW

Hi Erin — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks David for the intro. I’ll take point for Customer Success and run the kickoff/enablement side. Quick alignment from the CS perspective:

- Agree that June 8 10am PT is a good target for the kickoff. Please include Tom and a compliance contact (we’ll ask for name).
- Success criteria (phase 1):
  • Stable sync of discharge summaries to our enrichment pipeline (no PII leakage)
  • For pilot: 95% enrichment accuracy threshold against a 500-record validation set
  • Ops: <200ms median token latency for enrichment calls in staging
- Risks: procurement redlines (affects SOW sign date), Epic FHIR scopes (we’ll need a test client ID), and the July blackout window.

Operational asks for kickoff:
1) Tom to confirm FHIR scopes and provide a staging client ID by Jun 4.
2) Procurement to share expected redline timeline.
3) Ava to nominate a day-1 power user for acceptance testing.

Monica — can you draft a 6-week implementation runway (pre-integration tasks + integration + pilot validation) and post it to the shared drive? I’ll prepare the success criteria doc and the onboarding checklist.

Agenda stub I’ll share before EOD: kickoff-agenda.docx (attached).

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

On May 29, 2027 at 9:40 AM Erin Dwyer <erin.dwyer@avahealth.com> wrote:

Date: 2027-05-29T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Implementation staffing & RACI (draft)

Tessa / David —

Draft RACI and staffing notes for Ava Health integration (phase 1):

- CS Lead (R): Tessa Morgan — onboarding plan, acceptance criteria, training.
- PM (A): Monica Patel — sprint planning, timeline, SOW deliverables.
- Solutions Engineer (C): Karthik Iyer — integration support, staging validation, performance tuning.
- AE (I): David Kim — commercial coordination and escalations.

Timeline (high-level, 6 weeks):
Wk0 (Jun 1–7): Kickoff, confirm FHIR scopes & staging client, procurement redline review
Wk1–2 (Jun 8–21): Connector dev & config, auth setup, smoke tests in staging
Wk3–4 (Jun 22–Jul 5): Pilot ingestion, validation against 500 records, tuning
Wk5–6 (Jul 6–Jul 19): Acceptance, runbook creation, production prep (note: July 20–31 is blackout)

Immediate asks to include in kickoff:
- Customer to provide Tom’s availability (confirmed Jun 8, tentatively) and a compliance contact for data residency confirmation.
- Procurement contact to flag any non-standard clauses; we’ll keep legal on standby for redlines.

I’ll create a shared task board and post the sprint milestones after the kickoff.

-Monica
Implementation Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Erin Dwyer <erin.dwyer@avahealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Thanks Monica — that timeline looks reasonable.

Confirming: Tom Hsu will be our technical lead and will join the kickoff. Compliance contact is Maya Singh (maya.singh@avahealth.com) and she’ll attend the kickoff to confirm data residency constraints.

Procurement will review SOW_AvaHealth_v1.pdf and send redlines to procurement@avahealth.com — they asked for a 3 business day review window. If you can provide a clean countersign path, that will speed things.

June 8 at 10am PT works for us — please send the calendar invite and agenda.

—Erin

Thanks everyone —
David Kim
